title: Two Oil Tankers Attacked Near Strait of Hormuz; UKMTO Issues Alert
detail: Two oil tankers were attacked near the Strait of Hormuz, prompting the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency to issue an alert confirming the incidents. The attacks represent a further escalation in maritime security risks, with direct implications for food and energy supply chains transiting the strait and broader regional food security.

title: G7 Nations Announce Coordinated Release of 100 Million Barrels from Strategic Reserves
detail: G7 nations announced a coordinated release of 100 million barrels of oil and diesel from strategic reserves in response to rising energy prices linked to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The move aims to stabilize global fuel markets and cushion the impact on food supply chains, which depend heavily on diesel for agricultural production and maritime transport through the strait.

media.caption: G7 nations coordinate strategic oil reserve release to curb rising energy prices
